title: I’m Afraid I Can’t Do That: Predicting Prompt Refusal in Black-Box Generative Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating prompt refusal rates using template sentences asking the model to write positive or negative poems about 100 notable US political figures, as well as reproducing prompts from news articles alleging political censorship.

Analyzing model refusal behavior using the Quora Insincere Questions dataset, which contains questions exhibiting regional prejudices (e.g., Indian versus Pakistani, North versus South Indian stereotypes), and identifying highly predictive n-grams indicating refusal.

Analyzing model refusal behavior on insincere Quora questions involving religious conflicts (e.g., Hindu versus Muslim) and observing the predictive weight of religious keywords (e.g., 'muslims') in prompt classifiers.

Comparing model compliance and refusal responses to prompts asking for jokes about men versus women, and analyzing the predictive weight of gendered n-grams (e.g., 'girls', 'men') in predicting model refusals.
